phase1_research.a2p_verdict: Route A: Low-Volume Standard 10DLC brand (EIN required) + 1 Low-Volume Mixed campaign ($1.50/mo) + 8 local numbers in one sender pool. One-time $19.50. ~$23.80/mo at 2,000 segments. Sole Proprietor = 1 number max (cannot do roster). 8 toll-free = snowshoeing risk, not recommended. Single toll-free = fastest bridge (TFV $0, 3-5 business days). Unregistered local traffic hard-blocked since Feb 2025.
phase1_research.existing_stack: No SMS code in agent-ops/western-heart/cape-jones (code search). Composio current catalog has Twilio+Telnyx toolkits (local install stale, venv missing). Paired Android streams his SMS to Muse and supports contacts.create.
phase1_research.lindy: Current Lindy = one personal assistant; texting via iMessage/SMS after owner verifies his number; one buyable voice number; $29.99-$199.99/mo credit plans. No per-agent numbers in current product.
phase1_research.oss: Transport wired from @opencoredev/sms-sdk v0.1.1 (MIT) — documented memory() mock + verified Twilio/Telnyx webhooks. Runner-up AgentLine (MIT, outbound SMS undocumented). No candidate ships a sender allowlist — implemented in gateway router.
phase1_research.providers: Telnyx cheapest (local $1/mo, SMS $0.004/segment); Twilio local $1.15/mo, SMS $0.0083; Plivo numbers $0.50/mo but reported enterprise-gate risk; Vonage least transparent.
